en.name: 6B45 body armor (EMR)
en.description: The 6B45 Body Armor is a modular body armor issued to RUAF frontline troops. The armor has soft inserts with the capability to use any standard Granit ballistic plate. This armor was developed as part of the Ratnik Soldier Modernisation program for the Russian Armed Forces (RUAF)

en.name: Crye AVS (Multicam Black)
en.description: The Crye Adaptive Vest System is modular plate carrier platform that can be configured for a variety of mission requirements, from a low-visibility carrier to a full load-bearing armored system. It was developed by Crye Precision and is used by military and law enforcement and Special Forces.

en.name: FCPC Alpha
en.description: Ferro Concepts Plate Carrier (FCPC) is a popular and adaptable line of lightweight tactical plate carriers designed by Ferro Concepts, used by military and law enforcement.

en.name: ADA TBAS Badlands
en.description: The TBAS plate carrier is the standard-issue modular body armor for the Australian Army. It is produced by the Australian Defence Apparel (ADA) and has been issued in several versions, with V5 being one of the most recent for special forces.

en.name: FCPC M81
en.description: Ferro Concepts Plate Carrier (FCPC) is a popular and adaptable line of lightweight tactical plate carriers designed by Ferro Concepts, used by military and law enforcement. This rig was made in custom M81 and includes Data link jammers paired with an MPU5 Radio.

en.name: Crye Precision JPC 2.0 Swimmer
en.description: The JPC 2.0 swimmer cut is  specialized, lightweight, and minimal armor vest made by Crye Precision. It is a variant of the standard JPC designed to accept swimmer cut plates.

en.name: S&S Precision PlateFrame Modular
en.description: The PlateFrame Modular (PF-M) tactical plate carrier made by the company S&S Precision. This is a unique, skeletonized body armor system used by military special operations units and tactical enthusiasts. Unlike traditional plate carriers, which use fabric bags to hold ballistic armor plates, the PF-M uses a rigid, frame-like harness made from a composite material to secure the plates.

en.name: JPC 2.0 (M81)
en.description: The JPC 2.0 swimmer cut is a specialized, lightweight, and minimal armor vest made by Crye Precision. It is a variant of the standard Jumpable Plate Carrier (JPC) 2.0, designed to accept swimmer cut plates. These plates are smaller and have a more aggressive cut around the shoulders, allowing for a greater range of motion compared to standard SAPI-cut plates.the vest features an all-mesh construction. This design promotes immediate water drainage, making it particularly useful for special operations involving maritime or amphibious environments.

en.name: S&S Precision PlateFrame Modular (Assaulter)
en.description: The PlateFrame Modular (PF-M) tactical plate carrier made by the company S&S Precision. This is a unique, skeletonized body armor system used by military special operations units and tactical enthusiasts. Unlike traditional plate carriers, which use fabric bags to hold ballistic armor plates, the PF-M uses a rigid, frame-like harness made from a composite material to secure the plates.

en.name: Spiritus Systems LV-119 plate carrier (Goons Edition)
en.description: A lightweight and highly modular plate carrier designed with adaptability in mind. The LV-119 offers excellent protection with minimal bulk, supporting front, back, and cummerbund-mounted armor while remaining comfortable for long raids. Modified for use by the Goons.
